sourceConflictNote: The districtwide 2026–27 start and dismissal table and the announced schedule change show regular daily dismissal for middle schools. The MMSD calendar hub and some school-level pages still display the prior middle-school Monday early-release schedule. This page follows the current districtwide table because it is the more specific source for 2026–27 dismissal times.
seoTitle: MMSD 2026–27 School Calendar: Key Dates & Breaks
seoDescription: MMSD 2026–27 calendar with staggered start dates, school breaks, conference days, Monday early release for elementary schools, the last day of school, and graduation dates.
heroSummary: MMSD students in 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood start school Tuesday, September 1, 2026. All students attend on their regular schedule Wednesday, September 2. Fall Break is November 25–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, Spring Break is March 22–26, and the last day of school is Thursday, June 10, 2027.
calendarNotes: Not every student starts school on September 1. Conference evenings and no-school conference days also vary across elementary, middle, and high schools. Elementary schools release early on Mondays; current middle and high school schedules use regular daily dismissal times.

customSections.label: MMSD Starts School in Two Stages
customSections.content: Not every student starts school on September 1. 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood start September 1; all other students begin September 2.

table.footnote: MMSD specifically lists 4K and Early Childhood as out on November 2 and April 5.

customSections.label: Monday Early Release: Elementary Schools Only
customSections.content: Elementary schools release early on Mondays. For 2026–27, MMSD middle schools use a regular daily dismissal schedule, and high schools also follow their regular schedules. Check the school-by-school start and dismissal table for exact dismissal times.

customSections.label: Which MMSD Calendar Should Families Use?
customSections.content: The district calendar does not include every bell time, school event, or religious observance. Use the annual calendar for district dates, the start and dismissal table for school hours, the religious calendar for observance guidance, and the individual school calendar for campus events.

customSections.label: What Happens If MMSD Uses All Its Snow Days?
customSections.content: MMSD says snow days are built into the calendar. If all of them are used, the district may hold school on a scheduled Staff Only Day. Wait for an MMSD announcement before treating any Staff Only Day as a make-up school day.

sourceReviewSummary: Sources checked include MMSD’s official calendar hub, complete 2026–27 school-year calendar, and current school-by-school start and dismissal information. The calendar hub still describes an earlier elementary-and-middle Monday rule; for 2026–27, this page follows the current districtwide start and dismissal table, which lists Monday early release only for elementary schools.
sourceReviewDetails: The first student date and the all-student regular-schedule date were transcribed separately.
Evening conferences and no-school conference days were labeled separately for elementary, middle, and high schools.
Elementary Monday early release is treated as weekly schedule guidance rather than repeated as individual calendar events.
Religious observances were not converted into holidays because MMSD treats them as accommodation and scheduling dates.
The June 9 graduation group remains tentative on the official page.
sourceMaintainerText: MySchoolDates Calendar Data Team using official Madison Metropolitan School District sources.
